meta.title: Three Marks modpack — download the manager
meta.description: A free Mir Tankov modpack: marks in battle, a battle log, session stats, a replay manager and dozens more components. Your own data only, fair play by design, no ads.

hero.title: Three Marks modpack
hero.lead: Your marks percentage right in battle, a battle log, session stats in the hangar and a replay manager — {count, plural, one {# component} other {# components}} for your own data and what the client already shows. One app installs and updates them.
hero.preparing: The first release is on its way — the button works as soon as the files are on the server.

trust.label: Why you can trust the modpack

fairPlay.title: Fair play
fairPlay.text: Nothing about enemies beyond what the client shows: no enemy reloads, no aiming help.

free.title: Free, no ads
free.text: Every component is free. The modpack does not need a Plus subscription.

lestaId.title: No passwords
lestaId.text: We never ask for your game password: you sign in to the site with Lesta ID, and the mod binds with a one-time code.

control.title: Everything switches off
control.text: Each component turns on and off separately, without reinstalling.

showcase.title: What's inside
showcase.lead: {count, plural, one {# component} other {# components}} in five sections. The core, the companion and the settings window always come along; the rest is your pick.
showcase.legend: “Default” means the component is in the “Recommended” set the manager offers first.

battle.title: Battle
battle.lead: Battle interface panels: your damage, your hits and what the client already shows.

hangar.title: Hangar
hangar.lead: Hangar conveniences that save clicks between battles.

marks.title: Marks and stats
marks.lead: Everything about marks and your form — in battle, in the hangar and on the site.

replays.title: Replays
replays.lead: Your replays in the mod window and on the site.

streamers.title: For streamers
streamers.lead: Streamer mode hides every panel on a key. The manager has a ready-made “Streamer” set with the panels viewers like to see.

damage_log.title: Battle log
damage_log.text: The whole battle in one place: your hits with the outcome, shell and target HP left, assisted damage and the hits on you.

team_hp.title: Team HP and score
team_hp.text: Total team HP and the score in place of the stock strip, optionally a bar per tank.

sixth_sense.title: Sixth sense lamp
sixth_sense.text: A big icon when the skill fires. Replaces the stock lamp.

pack_badge.title: Three Marks plate by names
pack_badge.text: The modpack plate after the vehicle icon and a row highlight in the player panels and the loading screen — on you and on every player with the mod who left their plate on. No site binding needed.

battle_loadout.title: Equipment in battle
battle_loadout.text: The game's own equipment and directive icons to the left of the shell bar, no labels, with a tooltip on hover.

gun_arc.title: Gun traverse limits
gun_arc.text: Markers by the reticle where the gun reaches its traverse limit, five styles to pick from. Only on vehicles with limited traverse.

bush_circle.title: 15 m circle
bush_circle.text: A circle on the ground: move further from the bush and your shot gives you away. On a key or always.

aim_info.title: Aim and shells
aim_info.text: The distance to any vehicle under the reticle; damage, penetration, velocity and module damage in the shell tooltip.

platoon_points.title: Platoon points
platoon_points.text: Points like in a platoon tournament: for damage, assist, frags and survival, by your own rules.

responsive_reticle.title: Responsive reticle
responsive_reticle.text: The gun marker follows the gun every frame instead of ten times a second. Dispersion and penetration work as in the game.

battle_hotkeys.title: Option hotkeys in battle
battle_hotkeys.text: The server reticle and the extended zoom on hotkeys right in battle, with a notice over the reticle.

crosshair.title: Crosshairs
crosshair.text: Presets of the stock reticle, the server reticle and 26 center markers to pick from, plus a reload timer and the drum next to the reticle.

aim_circle.title: Smaller aim circle
aim_circle.text: The game’s aim circle at 80, 70 or 60% of its size, like other modpacks do. Dispersion and the shot stay the same.

camera.title: Zoom and camera
camera.text: Camera presets, sniper zoom and stabilization — the game's own settings in one click.

minimap.title: Minimap
minimap.text: Size, opacity, vehicle labels and your view circles — only what the game's settings offer.

hud_layouts.title: Layout per battle type
hud_layouts.text: Its own panels for random battles, Onslaught, Front Line and events. Switches by itself.

auto_messages.title: Chat auto messages
auto_messages.text: Tells your allies about your own events: artillery hit you, ally damage, being spotted; your own texts and a pause.

chat_filter.title: Chat filter
chat_filter.text: Timestamps on messages; hides repeats, flood, command spam and the words you pick.

hangar_tweaks.title: Hangar tweaks
hangar_tweaks.text: A carousel of 1–5 rows and quick actions: demount equipment and the style, crew to barracks.

hangar_info.title: Clock and server
hangar_info.text: Time, server, ping and online in the hangar.

hangar_cleaner.title: Clean hangar
hangar_cleaner.text: No promo teaser and no offer banners.

notification_filter.title: Notification filter
notification_filter.text: Hides ads, sales and auctions in the notification center.

auto_resupply.title: Auto-resupply
auto_resupply.text: Repairs, shells, consumables and directives with one button — for a tank or the whole hangar.

quick_demount.title: Quick demount
quick_demount.text: In the equipment menu: your tanks that have it fitted. Pick one and it is removed in every setup.

personal_missions.title: Personal missions helper
personal_missions.text: The conditions of the missions in progress in the hangar and a list of all missions in the mod window.

comp7_helper.title: Onslaught divisions
comp7_helper.text: A card in the Onslaught hangar: the Champion and Legend thresholds, the role skill of the vehicle, your streak and your last battles.

event_trackers.title: Event trackers
event_trackers.text: The Triathlon round and the Trading Caravan tokens while the event runs.

depot_seller.title: Depot seller
depot_seller.text: Unused shells, modules, equipment and consumables, plus untrained reserve crew, in one go. Everything is off by default; the sale lists the items and the credits first.

auto_reserves.title: Auto personal reserves
auto_reserves.text: The chosen personal reserves turn on by themselves when the game starts and when they run out.

crew_xp.title: Crew XP
crew_xp.text: The XP and battles each crew member needs to the next skill, in the hangar and the tooltip.

hangar_space.title: Hangar switcher
hangar_space.text: Any hangar the game already has; event hangars stay as in the game.

hangar_looks.title: Hangar looks
hangar_looks.text: Our own “Three Marks” looks for the game’s hangar: night, sunset, steel and studio, with our color grading.

hit_viewer.title: Hit viewer
hit_viewer.text: Where you were penetrated and where you hit: after the battle, on the tank model in the hangar, with the angle and effective armor.

update_notice.title: New mod version
update_notice.text: A badge in the mods list and a notification about a new release; in the mod window, “Download on the site” and “Skip this version”.

preset_advisor.title: Build hints in the loadout
preset_advisor.text: Marks the site's recommended equipment and directives for your tank in the loadout window.

armor_view.title: Tank armor
armor_view.text: The tank’s armor in 3D on the site: the “Tank armor” button in the mods list or the “Tank armor” item in the carousel tank menu (right click). Opens in your browser or in the game, as you choose.

free_camera.title: Free camera
free_camera.text: The game's own video camera on a key in replays and the hangar. Never in a live battle.

marks_panel.title: Marks of Excellence
marks_panel.text: Two components with their own settings: “Marks in battle” shows the percent, the post-battle projection, the battle’s damage bar and the damage to the next goal; the “Tank card” in the hangar shows the trend, the 65/85/95/100% scale with the damage for each mark and the battles to the next one.

battle_progress.title: Battle progress
battle_progress.text: One plate: the damage still needed for the High Caliber medal (random battles) and this battle’s WN8 (once the mod is bound).

session_stats.title: Session
session_stats.text: Battles, win rate, damage and WN8 of the session, the MoE change per tank, the last battles, site goals and your account.

battle_results.title: Battle results
battle_results.text: A summary after every battle in the notifications and the map of hits on your tank in the mod window; in battle, the previous battle’s results when they arrive in the next one.

replay_manager.title: Replay manager
replay_manager.text: All your replays with map, tank and result: search, filters, playback from the hangar and upload to the site.

replay_upload.title: Replay auto-upload
replay_upload.text: Uploads the replays of your battles to the site. Off until you turn it on.

streamer_mode.title: Streamer mode
streamer_mode.text: A key hides every mod panel for OBS scenes; the private mode hides the chat and your numbers.

fairPlay.title: Fair play
fairPlay.lead: Lesta punishes mods that reveal enemies, help aiming or change vehicle stats. The modpack has none of that and never will: the manager says what each component reads.

reads.results: The personal block of your battle results
reads.dossier: Your tanks’ dossier: marks and average damage
reads.feedback: Your damage and assist — the same events the stock log shows
reads.loadout: Your tank’s equipment, consumables and crew in the hangar
reads.accounts: The battle’s account numbers — for the modpack plate

never.enemies: Shows no enemies or spotting beyond the client
never.aim: Gives no aiming, dispersion or lead hints
never.stats: Changes no vehicle stats and no object transparency
never.others: Sends no other players' data from battle results

bans.label: accounts
bans.text: That many accounts Lesta blocked for forbidden mods in a single month.

install.title: How to install
install.lead: Three steps. The manager does the rest.

download.title: Download the manager
download.text: An installer for Windows 10 and 11. It has no code-signing certificate yet, so Windows may warn you: click “More info” → “Run anyway”.

pick.title: Pick a set
pick.text: The manager finds Mir Tankov by itself. Take a ready-made set or tick the components by hand.

play.title: Install and play
play.text: The manager leaves other mods alone unless you tick them for removal yourself. The Three Marks window opens from the mods button in the bottom-right corner of the hangar.

install.restart: On the first start the game may restart once — that is how the OpenWG Gameface library hooks up the mod window.

bind.title: Bind the mod to the site
bind.text: Unbound, the mod works in the game and sends only the battle’s account numbers for the modpack plate. Once bound, your battles, marks and sessions show up on the site, and your ratings and goals in the hangar. The code is single-use; bound computers are listed in your account.

manager.hint: Nothing opened? <link>Install the Three Marks manager</link> and click again.

managerApp.title: A manager, not an installer
managerApp.lead: It stays with you after the install: it turns components on and off without reinstalling and keeps an eye on patches.

sets.title: Sets and builds
sets.text: Four ready-made sets and up to 12 of your own. Share them as a code or a file.

profiles.title: Settings profiles
profiles.text: Your panel settings in a profile: save, switch, send to a friend as a code or a link.

sync.title: Sync with the site
sync.text: Sets and profiles are kept on the site, so a new computer does not lose them. Syncs on a button.

patches.title: Updates after a patch
patches.text: A patch is out — the manager moves the modpack to the new folder or installs a compatible version as soon as it is out.

safeInstall.title: Safe install
safeInstall.text: Packages are downloaded and checked first. If an install fails halfway, the previous files go back in place.

conflicts.title: Conflict check
conflicts.text: Finds XVM, PMOD and other mods that duplicate your components and shows what overlaps.

perf.title: FPS cost
perf.text: Every component shows how much it loads the game, with a “Light only” filter.

report.title: Report a problem
report.text: Collects the logs, hides anything personal and sends them to us. You see every file before sending.

switches.title: What goes to the site
switches.lead: Once bound: your own account’s events, signed with the device key. Unbound: only the battle’s account numbers for the modpack plate. Each item turns off in the mod window.

battleResults.title: Battle results
battleResults.text: Map, mode, result, your tank, damage, assist, spotting, frags, XP, credits, the marks after the battle and your platoon.

moeSnapshots.title: Marks in the hangar
moeSnapshots.text: The selected tank's percentage and average damage — only when they change.

queueTimes.title: Queue time
queueTimes.text: How long you waited for a battle and on which tank.

loadouts.title: Tank loadout
loadouts.text: Equipment, consumables, directives, shells, field modification and crew skills — for the build stats.

shots.title: Your hits
shots.text: Damage, outcome and distance of your shots at enemies, without positions — for “Honest RNG”.

badge.title: Modpack plate
badge.text: At battle start, the battle’s account numbers: the site answers who has the plate and keeps no copy of the list. While the switch is on, the site remembers for 30 days that your account has the mod; switch it off and that mark is deleted at once.

shareSettings.title: Game settings
shareSettings.text: Graphics, camera, reticle and sound — only when you press “Send to the site” yourself. Login, hardware and mods never go.

replays.title: Replays
replays.text: Your replays the game recorded. Only you see them until you turn publishing on.

idle.title: Session end
idle.text: Minutes without battles after which a new session starts.

ban.question: Can the modpack get me banned?
ban.answer: No: every component is checked against Lesta's list of forbidden mods. What the modpack reads and what it never does is in the Fair play section above.

patch.question: What happens after a patch?
patch.answer: The manager notices the new client version. If the modpack is compatible, it moves it to the new folder by itself. If a new version is needed, it installs it as soon as it is out. Your mod settings stay.

conflicts.question: Can I run it with XVM, PMOD or another modpack?
conflicts.answer: Yes, but the same panels will show twice. The manager checks the mods folder and shows which mods overlap your components — turn off the extra ones on our side or theirs. It removes other mods only when you tick them in the install wizard and confirm, and that removal cannot be undone.

perf.question: Will it cost me FPS?
perf.answer: Most components react to events and barely load the game. The ones that work every frame are marked in the manager. For a weak PC there is the “Minimal (FPS)” set: only the marks in battle, the lamp and the clean hangar.

remove.question: How do I remove the modpack?
remove.answer: In the manager: “Maintenance” → “Remove the modpack”. Only our files go; the mod settings and the site binding can go too or stay in case you come back. When you uninstall the manager itself, Windows asks whether to remove the modpack from every client too; the mod settings then stay. Other mods stay where they are.

bind.question: Why bind the mod to the site?
bind.answer: Unbound, the mod works in the game and sends only the battle’s account numbers for the modpack plate. Once bound, your battles, marks and sessions show up on the site, and your ratings and goals in the hangar. Get a new code in your account; old computers are unbound there too.

replays.question: Does the mod upload replays?
replays.answer: Only if you turn on auto-upload in the mod window — it is off by default, and only you see the uploaded replays until you turn publishing on. You can also upload a replay by hand.

delete.question: How do I delete my data?
delete.answer: Unbind the device in your account; on its Overview page you can download or delete your data. The plate mark on the server goes away when you switch off “Show my badge” in the mod window.

cta.title: Try it in your next battle
cta.text: Setup takes a couple of minutes, and if you change your mind, the modpack comes off as easily as it goes on.

meta.title: Three Marks modpack profile
meta.description: Open a modpack settings profile in the Three Marks manager or add it by code in the game.

profile.title: Modpack profile
profile.description: Someone shared a modpack settings profile with you: which components are on and how they are set up.
profile.managerNote: The manager opens “Profiles” with this code; you only confirm the import.
profile.gameNote: Without the manager: copy the code and paste it in the game — the mod window, “Profiles”, “Add from code”.
profile.missingTitle: The link has no profile code
profile.missingDescription: The link is cut off or outdated. Ask for a new one, or paste the code into the manager by hand: “Profiles” → “Import”.
